h: Israel Becomes a New Bride on Every Shabbos

p: and as a bride adorns herself with her jewels" (Yeshayahu 61:10).
The Name Havayah is called in the aspect of the groom,
which is the aspect of the Name Adnus,
is called by the name bride.
And the third meal of Shabbos
corresponds to Yaakov Avinu, peace be upon him,
whose image is engraved on the Throne of Glory;
הַיְינוּ שֶׁהוּא מַה שֶּׁנֶּאֱמַר (בְּרֵאשִׁית א, כו)
that is, he is what is said (Bereishis 1:26):
for he was like Adam HaRishon before the corruption;
and as written (in Rashi, Vayeitzei, Bereishis 29:21):
rather, to beget offspring he said so";
for he was as before the corruption,
it is stated in the Gemara (Bava Metzia 84a):
resembled the beauty of Adam HaRishon";
and in the holy Zohar (Zohar I 142b):
was the very beauty of Adam."
And therefore he is a chariot for the Name Havayah,
and this is "As a groom wears priestly splendor."
"And as a bride adorns herself with her jewels":
that Knesses Yisrael will lack nothing
of all the adornments of a bride.
once the days of her rejoicing are over,
דְּכַלָּה הוּא רַק ז׳ יְמֵי הַמִּשְׁתֶּה
For a bride is so only for the seven days of feasting,
וְאַחַר כָּךְ לֹא נִקְרָא עוֹד כַּלָּה
and afterward she is no longer called a bride;
in the aspect of a bride.
And this is because on Shabbos
"a soul in which there is all perfection,
in the likeness of the World to Come,"
כְּמוֹ שֶׁכָּתוּב בְּזֹהַר הַקָּדוֹשׁ (זֹהַר חֵלֶק ב פח, ב)
as written in the holy Zohar (Zohar II 88b);
and through this they are called a bride.
וִימֵי הַמַּעֲשֶׂה הֵם ז׳ יְמֵי הַמִּשְׁתֶּה
And the days of work are the seven days of feasting;
they attain a soul newer still,
and it is a new bride,
And likewise of the future they said (Berachos 64a):
לֹא בָּעוֹלָם הַזֶּה וְלֹא בָּעוֹלָם הַבָּא
neither in this world nor in the World to Come,
he appears before God in Tziyon.'"
That is, all the days of work
and on Shabbos "he appears before God,"
for it is the day of rest,
וּבְנוּחֹה יֹאמַר שׁוּבָה ה׳ (בְּמִדְבַּר י, לו)
"and when it rested he would say, Return, Hashem" (Bamidbar 10:36).
And it says, "As a groom wears priestly splendor";
"Just as a kohen is at the head,
so too a groom is at the head."
For of the priestly garments it is written (Shemos 28:2):
their priesthood is on them," etc.;
he is not a kohen at all.
And it says of Yisrael too
that they are like a groom;
וְהוּא עַל פִּי שֶׁאָמַר (בְּרֵאשִׁית רַבָּה פָּרָשָׁה יא)
and this follows what it says (Bereishis Rabbah 11:8):
Knesses Yisrael will be your partner";
it is evident that Yisrael are called
in the aspect of a groom,
for they bring holiness into Shabbos;
and this is what He said:
זָכוֹר אֶת יוֹם הַשַּׁבָּת לְקַדְּשׁוֹ (שְׁמוֹת כ, ח)
"Remember the day of Shabbos to sanctify it" (Shemos 20:8),
that is, to bring holiness into Shabbos
And so on Shabbos they are
and this corresponds to "garments of salvation";
and "He has wrapped me in a robe of righteousness"
"and as a bride adorns herself with her jewels,"
